'''Nations Quake Rank 8''' was one of the worst season concerning activity. There were six divisions, three to six were split up in half. Division one started out with twelve teams and ended with only seven. The playoff structure was adapted to that, of the clans that finished the season only [[image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Insanity]] missed out the playoffs. Even before the season started [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Tribe of Tjernobyl]] dropped and they were later followed by [[image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Slackers]], [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Lege Artis]], [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Campbusters]] and [[image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Hard Guns Crew]]. The top two teams, [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Fragomatic]] and [[image:flag_se.gif]] [[Griffins Tappra Gossar]], got a bye into the semifinals of the playoffs.
